title: 甜甜圈巨头：利润大涨340基点，为何仍亏损44亿
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Just turn around that you've been doing, focusing on having more franchise stores.
segments.zh: 你一直在进行的转型，重点是增加特许经营门店。

segments.en: It's working with your improved margins. How much more operational efficiency do you think you can squeeze out, or do you need
segments.zh: 随着利润率改善，这一策略奏效了。你认为还能挤出多少运营效率，还是需要重新聚焦于恢复营收增长？

segments.en: to kind of refocus on getting that top line growth back?
segments.zh: 还是需要重新聚焦于恢复营收增长？

segments.en: It has good morning, great to see you. Yeah, the turnaround we announced a year ago is working and you're right, we've seen margins
segments.zh: 早上好，很高兴见到你。是的，我们一年前宣布的转型正在奏效，你说得对，本季度利润率有所改善。
本季度利润率提高了340个基点。

segments.en: That's contributed also to our ability to pay down the leverage for down 1.3 turns on that.
segments.zh: 这也帮助我们降低了杠杆，下降了1.3倍。

segments.en: But perhaps most important for the future and to your point is we're also seeing good underlying growth.
segments.zh: 但也许对未来最重要的是，我们也看到了良好的潜在增长。

segments.en: If you exclude the business we exited last year, distribution of McDonald's, we actually grew 4.4% in the second quarter, which is a really good sign.
segments.zh: 如果排除我们去年退出的业务，即麦当劳的分销，我们第二季度实际上增长了4.4%，这是一个非常好的迹象。

segments.en: And so I see a going forward that will be able to continuously improve the margins like you say, but also at the same time grow the business because people want our donuts.
segments.zh: 因此，展望未来，我们将能够像你所说的那样持续改善利润率，同时也能发展业务，因为人们想要我们的甜甜圈。

segments.en: Well, again, on the margin side, I'm wondering if you're having any impact from all of the inflation that we have seen that our people worried about, and whether you feel you have
segments.zh: 再次谈到利润率，我想知道我们看到的通胀是否对你产生了影响，人们对此感到担忧，你是否觉得你有……

segments.en: any pricing power to make up for it.
segments.zh: 任何定价权都无法弥补这一点。

segments.en: We've made a lot of operational improvements over the last year.
segments.zh: 过去一年，我们做了很多运营改进。
